title: A stranger's first ride
persona: Someone who just installed Jerv, has never seen it, is signed out, and wants to start a walk right now.
goal: Without signing in, start a ride from the map: answer the walking-or-riding question, allow location when asked, watch the ride screen for a minute, then stop the ride and read the ride summary to the end.
success: A ride summary is on screen, its headline is not '+0', and nothing on the ride screen asked to sign in at the moment the ride started.
